svg.aria-label: Komitake: connect a Fuji kart to your PC
svg.title: Komitake
svg.desc: Banner with Komitake wordmark and description on the left, and a transparent dot-matrix of Mount Fuji with Komitake on the northern flank on the right. Colors adapt to light and dark page themes.

text.tspan: A Go daemon and CLI that connects a
"Fuji" RC kart to your PC over Wi-Fi.
